description.en: Thin wrapper around CMND_RESERVE_MAP_JUMP — reserves a map transition to happen once the current event/cutscene finishes.
ID of the map to jump to.
Target position/spawn point on the destination map.
Optional; whether to suppress the destination map's BGM (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Reserve a map jump to a specific map and spawn position
ReserveMapJump("mr01i22", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
